excluded: general receive window and challenge ACK

CONN-OPEN.interpretation: Select ISS; active OPEN enters SYN-SENT, passive OPEN enters LISTEN.

CONN-LISTEN.interpretation: A SYN in LISTEN initializes receive state and emits SYN+ACK; ACK-bearing input emits RST; RST is ignored.

CONN-SYN-SENT.interpretation: Validate ACK before processing SYN/RST; valid SYN+ACK establishes, bare SYN enters SYN-RECEIVED.

CONN-SIMULTANEOUS.interpretation: Figure 7: active vs passive origin is retained in SYN-RECEIVED; simultaneous SYN+ACK completes synchronization.

CONN-ACK.interpretation: In-order ACK completes synchronization or acknowledges FIN, with per-state transitions.

CONN-FIN.interpretation: FIN consumes one receive sequence number, is acknowledged, and changes per-state close progression.

CONN-CLOSE.interpretation: CLOSE in ESTABLISHED or CLOSE-WAIT emits FIN and enters FIN-WAIT-1 or LAST-ACK; repeated close does not emit a second FIN.

CONN-ABORT.interpretation: ABORT sends RST in the specified synchronized states; other states discard the TCB without output RST.

CONN-RESET.interpretation: Exact RCV.NXT resets the connection; passive SYN-RECEIVED returns to LISTEN, active origin closes.

CONN-CLOSED-INPUT.interpretation: CLOSED ignores resets and emits a correctly formatted reset for other control segments.

CONN-TIMEOUT.interpretation: User timeout deletes the TCB; retransmission timeout repeats oldest outstanding segment; TIME-WAIT timeout closes.

RTO-PROFILE.interpretation: Use 1000ms initial SYN RTO and exponential doubling for control retransmission. After a SYN timeout use at least 3000ms for subsequent FIN, retaining a larger backed-off value; no RTT estimator is modeled.

CONNECTION-PROFILE.interpretation: Single connection; zero payload; validated control shapes; exact sequence checks; no window/challenge-ACK/RTT/congestion behavior; 30s configurable user deadline and 60s configurable MSL.
